title: Two test files fail when test order is shuffled: app/lib/outbound-fetch-deadline.test.ts and widget-src/src/components/HealthTool.list-departure.test.tsx share state or fake timers between cases
evidence: Adversary review of screening Change 1, 2026-11-12: passes 37/37 in order, fails 4 cases under --sequence.shuffle; review-note issue 1333. Fixed 2026-11-13, tests only. Deadline: youtube-bot-api's cached access token leaked from one tick case into the next (seed 3 failed); vi.resetModules() per tick case. List-departure: the heard log-off latches health writes for the page's life, so the case poisoned later ones (seeds 1, 3, 5 failed); it moved to HealthTool.list-departure-log-off.test.tsx. After: deadline 15/15 and list-departure 21/21 in order and under seeds 1-10; log-off file 1/1
